next.name: Next.js (App Router)
steps: Import the stylesheet once, in the root layout.
Wrap children in FujiProvider there. The layout stays a Server Component - a Server Component may render a Client Component, so no "use client" is needed on layout.tsx.
Set the appearance on the provider. No component takes a theme, radius or elevation prop.
gotchas: A Server Component may render a compound root, but must not read a sub-part off it (Dialog.Content) - import the named sub-export (DialogContent) instead.
Presentational components (Icon, Typography, Card, Timeline) are Server Components; check `clientComponent` on a component before passing it a handler.

vite.name: Vite, Create React App, or any bare React DOM tree
steps: Import the stylesheet once at the entry point.
No Tailwind setup is required - the package ships pre-compiled CSS.
gotchas: The stylesheet ships no Tailwind preflight, so it will not reset the host app's styles - and the host app must not rely on Fuji to provide one.
A consuming app with its own Tailwind build does not need to scan Fuji's source; the utilities are already compiled.
